hypothesis.title: Unhandled Tool Error: stripe_process_refund 504 Gateway Timeout
hypothesis.explanation: Tool stripe_process_refund experienced a 504 Gateway Timeout at evt_104 after 2980ms. The missing try/catch and absence of backoff retry caused unhandled rejection propagation to evt_105, crashing the worker agent process.
hypothesis.suggestedFix: Implement an exponential backoff jitter retry policy around stripe_process_refund and enqueue a dead-letter event upon 504 timeout rather than aborting process.
